metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Mamma Mia!
metas.description: Independent hotelier Donna is preparing for her daughter's wedding with the help of two old friends. Meanwhile, spirited bride-to-be Sophie invites three men from her mother's past in order to discern which is her biological father.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.6 · 2018 · Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
metas.description: Five years after the events of Mamma Mia! (2008), Sophie prepares for the grand reopening of the Hotel Bella Donna as she learns more about her mother's past.
